newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville lowers Mon firm, off-peak power $7/MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville lowers Mon firm, off-peak power $7/MWh.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) dropped offer prices for firm power during off-peak hours on Monday by $7.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Friday.
BPA also increased the limit for firm off-peak power delivered Monday to 300 megawatts (MW), compared with 200 MW for Friday pre-schedulings.
Monday firm on-peak power was offered at $30.00 per MWh in the Northwest and $31.00 at the California-Oregon border (COB), while off-peak was offered at $23.00 for all deliveries.
BPA also offered non-firm off-peak power for Monday at $23.00-25.00 per MWh.
Prices for Saturday ranged from $22.00-23.00 for firm off-peak power and $29.00-30.00 for power during peak demand hours.
Sunday prices were lower at between $20.00 for firm power during light load hours and $24.00 for non-firm during heavy load hours.
